Independent adversarial review at `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45` on 2026-09-10. This records the completed report before disposition or fixes; it is not a clean-review gate receipt. Actual runtime: `gpt-6-astra`, effort `high`.

Independent adversarial review of topij/agentic-dev-kit PR #731. I did not write the submitted code and did not start another agent.

Repository handed to me: `/private/tmp/item5-b-kit-repair-1kc2i4t2/reviews/b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45/adversarial/handed-tree`.
Actual placed HEAD, observed with `git rev-parse HEAD`: `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45`.
Reviewed revision: `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45`, against `f408039dc3a9b0d2e0e8d246c126af892839cee8`.
On 2026-09-10, `git diff --stat f408039dc3a9b0d2e0e8d246c126af892839cee8...b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45` printed `98 files changed, 61589 insertions(+), 45 deletions(-)`. The nonempty full pinned diff is retained in [review-diff.log](review-diff.log), with [diffstat.log](diffstat.log).

The remote URL was `https://github.com/topij/agentic-dev-kit.git`. The wrapped `git ls-remote https://github.com/topij/agentic-dev-kit.git refs/heads/main refs/heads/chore/item5-b-review-repair-20260910` on 2026-09-10 returned main `f408039dc3a9b0d2e0e8d246c126af892839cee8` and the review branch `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45`. This established the supplied base against the remote, rather than a local ancestry check. See [remote-base-retry.log](remote-base-retry.log).

Scratch clone: `/private/tmp/item5-b-kit-repair-1kc2i4t2/reviews/b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45/adversarial/mut-adversarial-b018a054-6da874y3/repo`, created at a fresh lens/revision-namespaced path using `git clone --no-hardlinks`. The sandbox allowed that route and writes to the owned review directory. Initial sandboxed network routes failed DNS for GitHub and PyPI; elevated remote/full-suite retries were approved and succeeded in reaching their destinations. The focused network attempt also failed DNS before executing the harness; its offline retry used the populated cache. No auto-review rejection or filesystem-route refusal occurred. No removal/recreation, fetch into the handed tree, or copied Git administrative pointers were used.

**P2 — inherited detector blind spot for a FIFO at the state root; not a regression.**

Location: `scripts/conftest.py:237-240`. A test that calls `os.mkfifo(<repo>/state)` leaves a persistent obstruction but reaches neither the regular-file branch nor the directory traversal. The snapshot remains empty and pytest exits successfully with no guard banner. The reviewed production `pr_watch.save_state()` then raises `NotADirectoryError` at its `STATE_DIR.mkdir(...)` call when directed at that scratch state root. This is an actual persistence failure, not a claim that the whole hosted workflow or merge gate was bypassed.

The offline behavioral harness on 2026-09-10 reproduced this with guard bytes from `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45` and from `f408039dc3a9b0d2e0e8d246c126af892839cee8`, in flat `scripts` and nested `scripts/devkit` layouts. Every FIFO pytest probe exited `0`; every corresponding call to the reviewed `save_state()` exited `1` with `NotADirectoryError`. The base comparison replaces only the guard in the synthetic probe; it is not a full base-suite run. Exact subprocess argv/cwd are in [behavior-results.json](behavior-results.json), and full outputs include [FIFO probe](fifo-new-scripts.stdout.log), [base FIFO probe](fifo-new-base-scripts.stdout.log), and [production persistence traceback](fifo-new-scripts-save-state.stderr.log).

This is outside the approved regular-file repair, and does not justify silently broadening its payload. Document the root-special-file limitation and disposition it separately; any extension should record special nodes without opening them. Root-symlink and observation-window exclusions remain distinct.

All results below are observations on 2026-09-10, in `/private/tmp/item5-b-kit-repair-1kc2i4t2/reviews/b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45/adversarial/mut-adversarial-b018a054-6da874y3/repo`, at `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45` with only the explicitly shown temporary mutation overlays. Synthetic probe directories and base-guard substitutions are recorded per case. Test processes ran beneath the required `serial-verify.py` wrapper, with its shared lock and isolated state/cache environment.

- `make test` reached its terminal summary: `1 failed, 2503 passed, 1 skipped in 380.53s (0:06:20)`, make exit `2`. The failure was `scripts/tests/test_pr_followup_hook.py::test_a_payload_too_deep_for_json_load_still_exits_zero`, matching the disclosed #393 assertion (`out` was nonempty). This is not a full-suite pass. [Full output](make-test-retry.log).
- The independent `review-cases.py` harness rejected empty root-file creation, root-file deletion, file-to-directory replacement, and directory-to-file replacement in the flat and nested layouts: inner pytest exit `1`, guard banner and `['./']` reported. Root-symlink-to-file creation remained undetected, consistent with the declared exclusion. The shipped new/modified/unchanged cases were exercised in the focused runs. [Full behavioral log](behavioral-and-mutations-offline.log).
- Separate `bash -n` calls for `scripts/dev_session.sh`, `scripts/reconcile_sessions.sh`, `scripts/lib/repo_root.sh`, and `scripts/hooks/pre-push`, plus `sh -n init.sh`, each exited `0`. These cover the #561 parse omission, not shell runtime behavior. [Output](final-attestation.log).

Mutation command, inside the wrapper-provided uv Python environment:

```sh
python -B -m pytest scripts/tests/test_state_guard.py scripts/tests/test_kit_doctor.py::test_kit_repo_self_check_is_clean -q -m 'not driftcheck'
```

The drift test was explicitly included in selection and then deselected by its marker; the output reported `1 deselected`. The failures came from behavioral assertions that the inner pytest process must reject a persisted write, not stored-text/hash comparisons.

First mutation, [full landed diff](mutation-drop-root-file.diff):

```diff
-        return {"./": _hash_file(state_dir)}
+        return {}
```

Result: `4 failed, 49 passed, 1 deselected in 16.84s`, exit `1`. The failing cases were `new-flat`, `new-nested`, `modified-flat`, and `modified-nested` in `test_guard_observes_regular_file_at_state_root`. [Full output](mutation-drop-root-file.stdout.log).

Next mutation, [full landed diff](mutation-constant-root-hash.diff):

```diff
-        return {"./": _hash_file(state_dir)}
+        return {"./": "<file>"}
```

Result: `2 failed, 51 passed, 1 deselected in 12.53s`, exit `1`. The failing cases were `modified-flat` and `modified-nested` in the same behavioral test. [Full output](mutation-constant-root-hash.stdout.log).

The harness saved the original bytes via `git show b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45:scripts/conftest.py`, wrote each mutation, reread it, required exact equality to the intended mutant and inequality to the original, and retained the unified diff before testing. After each case it restored and compared the original bytes before continuing. Both restoration records contain `byte_equal: true` and SHA-256 `a0a82682c9431205f8c0db80176694b37800da7964e5b77ec3eba283fc7569c2`: [drop-branch restoration](mutation-drop-root-file.restoration.json), [constant-hash restoration](mutation-constant-root-hash.restoration.json).

After restoration, the same focused pytest command without `-m 'not driftcheck'` printed `54 passed in 12.57s`, exit `0`, including the manifest self-check. [Output](restored-focused.stdout.log). These executions demonstrated detection of the tested regular-file changes and behavioral sensitivity to the submitted branch; they do not establish protection outside the documented observation window or invocations that load this conftest.

**Attestation.** I followed Fresh context, No framing, Not the author, Report, don't fix, No writes in the tree you were given, Scratch namespace, and Right revision. Production mutations were confined to my private clone; synthetic probe trees were under the owned directory, outside the handed tree. I made no repository-policy, historical-evidence, retained-tree, forge, tracker, client, trust, or profile edits and performed no merge. The original handed tree was never edited, checked out, detached, or repointed by me.

The final wrapped `git status --short` on 2026-09-10 at `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45` printed no entries for either the handed tree or private clone. `git rev-parse HEAD` still returned `b018a0544c44028c21399ad073ce8a3dee3bfd45` for each, and the guard byte comparison matched the reviewed source. [Final attestation output](final-attestation.log). Status establishes no reported tracked changes or untracked scratch; it does not prove no historical ref change or transient write. My no-repoint/no-edit statement is the action attestation, separate from that evidence.

Every verification process started by this lens reached a terminal status; none was timed out or abandoned. Initial network failures are retained and are not behavioral results. Nested probes emitted `Unknown config option: cache_dir` because the required wrapper sets that option while their commands disable the cache provider; their exact exit and guard assertions were still checked. No hosted-CI, merge-readiness, retained-fixture field-exit, or blanket clean-review claim is made.

Exact top-level command records follow; the wrapper itself supplies the indicated cwd. Nested argv/cwd and statuses are retained in `behavior-results.json` and the full harness output.
